items.title_hr: Cibona započela pripreme za sezonu 2026./27. — nastupat će u tri natjecanja
items.title_en: Cibona begins preparations for the 2026/27 season — competing on three fronts
items.summary_hr: Cibona je u ponedjeljak, 10. kolovoza, započela pripreme za novu sezonu pod vodstvom trenera Ivana Rudeža, uz pomoćne trenere Nevena Nikolića i Andreja Štimca. Klub će nastupati u tri natjecanja — SuperSport Premijer ligi, ABA ligi i Košarkaškoj ligi prvaka — pa roster broji 17 igrača. Jan Palokaj propušta start sezone zbog ozljede, a momčadi se pridružio Domagoj Vuković. "Nakon dugog i radnog ljeta započeli smo pripreme za novu sezonu", izjavio je sportski direktor Marin Rozić.
items.summary_en: Cibona began preparations for the new season on Monday, August 10, led by head coach Ivan Rudež, with assistant coaches Neven Nikolić and Andrej Štimac. The club will compete in three competitions — the SuperSport Premier League, the ABA League and the Basketball Champions League — with a 17-player roster to cover the schedule. Jan Palokaj will miss the start of the season due to injury, while Domagoj Vuković has joined the squad. "After a long and busy summer, we've begun preparing for the new season," said sporting director Marin Rozić.
